direction: Owner requests nodes, cycles/batches, direct placement/size/stagger manipulation as primary authoring; retain previous first-use/edit integrity criteria.
reference: Owner-supplied Rat/Weasel dot timeline; existing enemy cutout artwork.

criteria.acceptance: Tune opens on editable canvas with enemy imagery, not a stack of numeric forms; selected node exposes only local controls.
Pointer move, duration/count manipulation and batch/stagger manipulation produce valid recipe changes and immediate compiled spawn changes.
Groups, batches and repeated sequences are visibly distinct; edits to shared repetition recipe announce affected copies.
Time geometry agrees with shared compiler, including trailing gap and repeat rests; invalid overlap never silently coerced or sorted.
Undo/redo preserves stable identities; cancellation leaves recipe intact; visual and expert edits cannot silently overwrite each other; Save & play uses current recipe.
Touch-size handles/actions; keyboard or explicit step controls provide gesture alternatives; selected status/errors visible; responsive canvas intentional scrolling/zoom.
Clear first task, one primary action, default JSON hidden, visible test setup, save/error feedback and production separation retained.

verification: Pointer drag/resize/count and stagger workflow,undo,replay/save inspection
limits: Expert critique and emulation do not establish owner acceptance or physical performance.
